title: Turnstile client widget mounts with the elicited sitekey and injects no third-party script beyond the Cloudflare Turnstile host
asA: shelf consumer applying the edge-cloudflare-turnstile v1.0.0 blueprint on a Workers project using the probe-pack-edge-cloudflare-turnstile fixture
iWant: the Turnstile widget to mount on my public form with the elicited TURNSTILE_SITEKEY, to inject only Cloudflare Turnstile JS and no other third-party script, and to populate the hidden cf-turnstile-response token field on submit
soThat: every submit that reaches my server carries a Turnstile response my server-side verifier can check and the browser has loaded no scripts I did not authorise

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the fixture page loads with the pinned always-pass test sitekey (1x00000000000000000000AA per https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/troubleshooting/testing/), the Turnstile widget mounts and an iframe whose src origin is https://challenges.cloudflare.com is present; the page loads no third-party script from any other origin; the form payload on submit carries a non-empty cf-turnstile-response value.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture form loaded with default sitekey=pass and the pinned always-pass test sitekey applied
acceptanceCriteria.when: the widget renders and the operator submits
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Turnstile widget is mounted, its iframe origin is Cloudflare Turnstile only, and the submit payload contains the cf-turnstile-response token

acceptanceCriteria.description: When the fixture page loads with the pinned always-fail test sitekey (2x00000000000000000000AB per https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/troubleshooting/testing/), the Turnstile widget mounts and an iframe whose src origin is https://challenges.cloudflare.com is present; the widget's always-fail branch is observable client-side and the form payload on submit carries a cf-turnstile-response value the server-side verifier will reject as invalid-input-response.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pack fixture form loaded with the pinned always-fail test sitekey (2x00000000000000000000AB)
acceptanceCriteria.when: the widget renders and the operator submits
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Turnstile widget is mounted from the Cloudflare Turnstile origin only, no third-party script from any other origin loads, and the submit payload carries a cf-turnstile-response value that the server-side verifier will reject per US-35103 AC-35103-1

acceptanceCriteria.description: The applied blueprint's manifest declares the `humanCheck` capability token and the elicited surface renders the Cloudflare Turnstile widget with the pinned test sitekey per AC-35101-1; therefore the `humanCheck` promise the manifest carries is backed by a live widget the applying project can submit through.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the applied blueprint manifest at `blueprints/edge-cloudflare-turnstile/blueprint.json` and the pack fixture serving the elicited surface at `packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/probe-pack-edge-cloudflare-turnstile/`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the widget-rendered check reads the blueprint manifest and mounts the fixture surface
acceptanceCriteria.then: the manifest carries `humanCheck` on its `capabilities[]` list and the fixture surface renders the Turnstile widget from the Cloudflare Turnstile origin only, so `humanCheck` is a live promise the applying project can act on
